messages.content:
You are returning a compact typed correction protocol for a validated project plan.
Resolve every listed error.
Every error code must appear exactly once in error_resolutions.
Do not generate source code. Do not create paths. Do not omit plan operations.
Use only the closed operation catalog and registered transforms.
A response with incomplete error coverage is invalid.
Project: health-boundary-probe | stack: nodejs-standard-library
Allowed existing paths: ["package.json", "server.js", "index.html", "test.js"]
Initial components: [frontend, backend, persistence, tests]; requested component: preview.
Initial preview strategy exists and must remain coherent; existing server.js contains /health.
Initial errors:
- MISSING_REQUESTED_COMPONENTS: Plano nao promete componentes pedidos: ['preview']. Acao: Adiciona os componentes pedidos e os respetivos ficheiros reais.
- MISSING_COMPONENT_MAPPING: Plano full stack sem component_files para: ['frontend', 'backend']. Acao: Mapeia frontend e backend para ficheiros que existam no plano.
- DECLARED_COMPONENT_WITHOUT_ARTIFACTS: O componente declarado frontend nao tem nenhum artefacto real mapeado. Acao: Mapeia frontend para pelo menos um ficheiro existente que implemente o componente.
- PERSISTENCE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: O componente persistence nao demonstra leitura e escrita duravel; estado em memoria nao e persistencia. Acao: Associa persistence a um artefacto existente que implemente leitura e escrita duravel.
- MISSING_HEALTH_ROUTE: Nenhum artefacto backend contem evidencia textual da rota /health. Acao: Implementa a rota de healthcheck no backend associado.
Operation catalog:
- set_components: complete final array.
- set_component_files: complete final paths for a component.
- apply_code_transform: server.js with ADD_JSON_FILE_PERSISTENCE and storage_filename. Integrity metadata is bound by the executor. Do not return hashes.
Transform catalog:
- ADD_JSON_FILE_PERSISTENCE: only server.js; adds node:fs, deterministic JSON path, durable read/write and missing-file handling; preserves node:http and /health; no external dependencies.
Error to operation compatibility:
- MISSING_REQUESTED_COMPONENTS -> set_components
- MISSING_COMPONENT_MAPPING -> set_component_files
- DECLARED_COMPONENT_WITHOUT_ARTIFACTS -> set_component_files
- PERSISTENCE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED -> apply_code_transform ADD_JSON_FILE_PERSISTENCE on server.js
- MISSING_HEALTH_ROUTE -> set_component_files backend server.js when /health already exists
The response must contain exactly two top-level keys: error_resolutions and operations.
Each operation id must be unique and each referenced operation id must exist.
Use no replace_file_content, replace_text, arbitrary code, file creation, diff, JSON Patch, append, retry or autorepair.
Do not return expected_sha256, sizes, timestamps or snapshot IDs. The executor calculates and binds trusted integrity metadata from the initial virtual snapshot.
Return JSON only.
